locator: I.17: fourth reply beginning Ad aliud dicendum est quod loquendo and Et hoc est quod dicit Commentator
interpretation: Bounded prose reading of the materialized Latin; no Lean declaration or mechanically verified inference is advertised. Reads the sign/constitutive-nature distinction, not the denial that substances have natures. Explaining or expressing in this semantic passage is not automatically efficient production, metaphysical grounding, or a sufficient epistemic explanation.
